title.text: Questions on national income, answered from a governed source

subtitle.text: This is a demonstration version of Governed RAG: the user asks a question, the passages are chosen and the figures supplied using code, and a language model's output is used only for a short, checked explanation.

walkthrough_intro.text: The walkthrough shows how Governed RAG works. You can follow one request, step by step, from the question to the checked reply. The step that uses the language model comes after code and data built for this subject, and before the code that checks the language model's output.

sandwich.text: Before the language model, code is used for the filters, the routing, reading the parameters from the question, finding the passages, supplying the figures and filling the template part. After it, code is used to check the explanation, record each step in the trace and count the tokens.

dn_licence.text: Demonstrator note: in this demonstration version, the licence filter has two use modes. In a full-scale production version, the access rights in each user's contract would be checked each time passages are found.

dn_direction.text: Demonstrator note: direction words are banned from the explanation, because the checks in this demonstration version cannot test them reliably. In a full-scale production version, the direction check would have a measured error rate and a review of each dropped explanation.

dn_size.text: Demonstrator note: this demonstration version covers the economies, passages and questions counted above, for one user on a laptop. In a full-scale production version, the catalogue would hold thousands of series and every document that could answer a question, for many users.

dn_owners.text: Demonstrator note: in this demonstration version, one person writes each definition and rating reason as the vertical domain expert and checks it as the horizontal domain expert. In a full-scale production version, each definition and rating reason would have a named owner in the team that produces the data, and a different person would check it.

reply_wording.NO_DQR: No DQR: this reply quotes passages only.
reply_wording.NO_PASSAGES: No passage in this use mode answers this question.
reply_wording.SERIES_HEADING: Series title (copied from the World Bank's list of series)
reply_wording.CLARIFY_LINE: This question is too vague to answer from the data. Pick one of these sharper questions:
reply_wording.NOT_BUILT: This question needs several steps planned in turn (route R6). That route is not built in this demonstrator.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_NOT_BUILT: Demonstrator note: a product would plan the steps itself, within a limit on steps, and show each one.
reply_wording.COMPARISON_LINE: People compare national accounts across economies to benchmark how each is doing. Check which measure is used and whether it is good enough for an international comparison.
reply_wording.EXPLANATION_HEADING: Explanation (written by a language model and checked against the figures above)
reply_wording.WITHHELD: The written explanation came from a language model and did not pass our quality checks, so it is not shown. Please contact our analyst if you want to know more.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_WITHHELD: Demonstrator note: this is a demonstration, not a product. A product would let you ask for the explanation to be refined, and would send your question to a named analyst. Here, no analyst receives it.
reply_wording.CORRECTED_HEADING: Corrected by the vertical domain expert
